title: Recover in the right order
prompt: You have found both causes. What do you do first?

options.text: Rerun the full crawl now with the same code.
options.feedback: The same code can swallow the next error and repeat the partial run.

options.text: Tear down the datasource and start clean.
options.feedback: teardown cannot be undone, and it removes everything users rely on.

options.text: Fix the client so auth errors fail the run, remove the test cap, then run a full crawl verified against expected counts.
options.feedback: Right. Never let a partial fetch finish as a successful full crawl. Fix the fault before you rerun.

takeaway: Fix the fault, then rerun a verified full crawl.
